cases.title: Decimal Comparison
cases.clean: Compare 9.8 and 9.11 as decimal numbers and explain which is larger.
cases.proposed_interpretation_to_inspect: Numerical surface form versus decimal magnitude.

The scene is a NASA space mission. An astronaut floats in zero gravity outside a spaceship, beside a space station orbiting Earth. Compare 9.8 and 9.11 as decimal numbers and explain which is larger.

The scene is a classical music concert. A violinist plays a violin concerto by Beethoven while an orchestra performs a symphony in the concert hall. Compare 9.8 and 9.11 as decimal numbers and explain which is larger.

The scene is a world chess championship. Magnus Carlsen moves a knight across the chessboard, attacks the queen, and checks his opponent's king. Compare 9.8 and 9.11 as decimal numbers and explain which is larger.
